old: To end your turn, click the “End Turn” button in the bottom-right corner of the screen, or press Ctrl+Space.
new: To end your turn, open the menu (MENU button) and choose “End Turn”.

old: Press Ctrl+R to recruit new soldiers. (Or right-click on a keep hex.)
new: Move onto your keep, then open the menu (MENU button) and choose “Recruit” to recruit new soldiers.

old: Tip: Press “u” if you ever want to undo a move. Attacks cannot be undone.
new: Tip: Press the D button if you ever want to undo a move. Attacks cannot be undone.

old: You may toggle tips on or off at any time during the campaign by right-clicking anywhere and selecting “Tips: On/Off” in the menu.
new: You may toggle tips on or off at any time during the campaign by opening the menu (MENU button) and selecting “Tips: On/Off”.

_comment: Notre extraction prend toujours la branche 'tutoriel passe' (limite d'architecture, cf. README) ; ce message accusait a tort le joueur d'avoir fait ce choix.
old: Because you skipped the tutorial, tips are currently off.

Rain or snow have no impact on gameplay. If weather is distracting or reduces performance, you can disable it by opening the Preferences menu (Ctrl-P), by selecting “Display” and unchecking “Animate Map.”
new: Rain or snow have no impact on gameplay.

old: I will need to recruit units if I want to weather the undead assault! I should first move to a keep, then press Ctrl+R to recruit or Alt+R to recall.
new: I will need to recruit units to weather the undead assault! First move to a keep, then use the menu (MENU button) to recruit or recall.

old: If you have high-XP survivors from previous battles, remember to press Alt+R and recall them so they can continue gaining experience and be promoted to higher levels.
new: If you have high-XP survivors from previous battles, recall them from the menu (MENU button) to keep gaining experience.

old: You are running out of turns to complete this scenario! See your objectives by pressing Ctrl+J, and remember that the turn limit can be seen in the top-left-hand corner.
new: Running out of turns! Check your objectives from the menu (MENU button); the turn limit is in the top-left corner.

old: To see what damage resistances and vulnerabilities a unit has, right-click it and select “Unit Type Description.”
new: Every unit’s damage resistances and vulnerabilities are shown in the info panel at the bottom of the screen.

old: For a full description of what one of your units can do, right-click it and select “Unit Type Description.”
new: Every unit’s full description is shown in the info panel at the bottom of the screen.

old: Use “Ctrl+R” to recruit a soldier first!
new: Open the menu (MENU button) and recruit a soldier first!

old: Press Ctrl+R to recruit new soldiers.
new: Open the menu (MENU button) and choose “Recruit” to recruit new soldiers.
